## Approved plan task C3

- **Functional scope/files:** shared web structs/validators, WebBridge and Channels request-context propagation. Add widget context, configuration scope, first-message seed-content validation and the section 4.6 event set. Init has no creation/seeding side effects. `prompt_context` uses C2's existing-history composition; no new prompt type or privileged runtime-context injection. Implement a fixture adapter in tests against the real public ingress.
- **Behavior:** same Message/Command as BO; adapter-verified `sender_id` mapped into the existing author contract and shared trusted context, People-resolved identity and Engine-authorized routing; bridge-managed mapping to adapter-supplied topics/events; safe public projection; typing/start/edit/step/complete/failure lifecycle. Optional visible steps carry summaries, not raw reasoning/private traces.
- **Execution ownership:** use one explicit owner for acceptance and terminal delivery; derive stable message IDs before the first update. Test normal pipeline delivery and pre-delivery fallback together. If request-local serialization/state is required, keep it in a bounded Channels transport owner with cleanup on success/failure/timeout, not in Engine or a permanent conversation store; specify its multi-node routing before implementation.
- **Tests before implementation:** identical shared message inputs for BO/widget; snapshot vs append streaming; create-before-update and terminal ordering; no double terminal on sync responses/fallback; errors before/after acceptance; isolation across two widgets/two conversations; malformed event mapping; allowed metadata projection; no privilege/topic override; reconnect/history recovery.
- **Branches:** async acceptance and events, C1-approved sync terminal return, sync init/history, no-stream final response, stream failure, missing subscriber, disabled config and inaccessible conversation.
- **Mocking:** actual PubSub/Engine/Repo; test adapter is an external-adapter fixture, not an internal production stub. External LLM deterministic.
- **Documentation:** versioned schema/event mapping and sync/async/delivery semantics; record no durable exactly-once or automatic uncertain-retry guarantee.
- **Action reuse:** reuse C2 operations and existing routing/pipeline/status/final delivery. Event encoding is local-only transport logic; no generic tool or workflow action is needed for serialization.
- **Done:** external developer can exercise the complete ZAQ message/init/history contract using the conformance fixture without a widget UI.

## Execution requirements
Branch: refactor/webbridge. Source: GitHub www-zaq-ai/zaq#830. Read AGENTS.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, and applicable service guides before implementation. Shared contracts, module responsibilities, reuse evidence, decisions and regression obligations are in parent zaq-pkd. Write specified immediate tests first; use real internal boundaries and mock only external edges. Preserve canonical-history authorization, config-scoped delivery and Engine admission/finalization. New/substantially rewritten feature E2E must wait for B3 human approval. Inbound message.edit is excluded; outbound streaming edits remain included.


## Sequencing
Blocked by zaq-pkd.10 (C2).
Blocks zaq-pkd.12 (C4).
Human BO approval: zaq-pkd.7. Persistent consolidated E2E/regression issue: zaq-pkd.8. Widget decision gate: zaq-pkd.9.

comments.text: C3 execution design before implementation: one bounded temporary Channels request owner per widget message, under existing BridgeSupervisor (no new supervision hierarchy). It subscribes to an unpredictable internal PubSub topic before dispatch; only a serializable Delivery snapshot/topic crosses role hops. Cluster PubSub routes updates from any Agent/Channels node back to the owner on the ingress Channels node, with no PID/function/credential in metadata. The owner maps safe semantic updates, emits stable assistant create-before-edit/step and one terminal, and cleans up on completion/failure/TTL. Sync awaits one terminal with server-configured 30s default; timeout returns unknown outcome without cancelling accepted work and later history remains recovery. Async returns first-message conversation-created or existing-chat accepted receipt before pipeline execution completes. Raw traces/tool calls are already excluded from widget final projection; BO unchanged. Event serialization/request bookkeeping is local-only; reuse existing NodeRouter admission/finalization and PubSub delivery, no Action/tool exposure.

title: [830] C3 — Extend shared contracts and delivery mapping for widget conformance
